correctness.rationale: The universal cover is a convex Euclidean strip and the even/odd deck translates give exhaustive lower envelopes u and sqrt((a-u)^2+(2b)^2). Circular boundary arclength difference folded at a gives U~Unif[0,a]. Equality of branches occurs at r*=a/2+2b^2/a; both branches are monotone on the stated ranges. Pushing forward uniform U yields the stated piecewise CDF and integrable sqrt singularity, no atoms; support endpoint and small-r slope recover b and a when b<a/2. With b>=a/2 the interior route never improves u, proving identical full boundary kernels for all such widths. Independent midpoint integration at (a,b)=(2,.4),(2,1),(4,3) matched analytic means within 1e-9. Numerical deck tests in bundled code are only consistency checks.
